themes.name: Product drops and collabs
themes.definition: Headlines announcing or reviewing a specific new product, colourway, reissue, capsule or brand collaboration (sneakers, beauty, spirits, cars, watches, fashion), unless the release is tied to a major sporting event.

themes.name: Celebrity and red carpet
themes.definition: Headlines about what named celebrities wore or did at awards, galas, premieres, festivals or public appearances, including red-carpet trend roundups.

themes.name: Campaigns and ambassadors
themes.definition: Headlines about a brand's advertising campaign, campaign film, brand ambassador or face signing, sponsorship of arts or culture, or brand activation event, excluding sports-event marketing.

themes.name: Fashion weeks and runway
themes.definition: Headlines reviewing or previewing runway collections, fashion week schedules, shows, street style at fashion weeks, or student graduate shows.

themes.name: Creative director moves
themes.definition: Headlines about the appointment, debut or departure of a creative, artistic or design director at a fashion or luxury house.

themes.name: Executive leadership changes
themes.definition: Headlines about the appointment, promotion, resignation or exit of a CEO, chair, board member or other non-design executive.

themes.name: Mergers, acquisitions and IPOs
themes.definition: Headlines about companies or brands being bought, sold, merged, taking stakes, raising investment, or planning or completing a stock market listing.

themes.name: Earnings and performance
themes.definition: Headlines reporting a company's sales, profits, quarterly or annual results, guidance, share-price moves or growth figures.

themes.name: Tariffs and supply chain
themes.definition: Headlines about tariffs, trade policy, freight rates, shipping disruption, energy or production costs, sourcing and manufacturing location.

themes.name: Consumer and macro outlook
themes.definition: Headlines about consumer confidence, retail sales data, footfall, economic growth, wealth trends or government economic policy affecting shoppers and retailers.

themes.name: Retail distress and bankruptcy
themes.definition: Headlines about bankruptcy, administration, liquidation, store closures, layoffs, clearance sales or brands shutting down.

themes.name: Store openings and expansion
themes.definition: Headlines about new or upsized physical stores, flagships, pop-ups, showrooms or a brand's entry into a new country or retail partner.

themes.name: AI in retail
themes.definition: Headlines about artificial intelligence applied to shopping, marketing, search, styling, product creation or the workforce in fashion, beauty and luxury.

themes.name: Creator and social commerce
themes.definition: Headlines about influencers, creator marketing, affiliate programmes, TikTok Shop, livestream shopping, retail media or social platforms as sales channels.

themes.name: Wellness and longevity
themes.definition: Headlines about wellness, longevity, peptides, GLP-1s, supplements, health wearables, aesthetic treatments or wellness hospitality as a business category.

themes.name: Resale and sustainability
themes.definition: Headlines about resale, vintage, rental, refills, circularity, environmental pledges, worker welfare or durability in the industry.

themes.name: World Cup and sports marketing
themes.definition: Headlines linking brands, kits, products or campaigns to the World Cup, Wimbledon, NBA, F1, Olympics or other major sporting events and athletes.

themes.name: Luxury travel and property
themes.definition: Headlines about luxury hotels, resorts, travel destinations, superyachts, private jets, or high-end homes and property listings.
